question:
Which of the following steps can be taken to mitigate landslides?

A. Settlements to be avoided in identified landslide-prone areas

B. Cutting of unnecessary trees and vegetation

C. Building strong walls

D. Not constructing drainage systems to avoid constructions
solution:
The correct answer is __**A and C**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Option 4** is correct because it includes both A and C, which are effective measures for mitigating landslides.
 
• **A. Settlements to be avoided in identified landslide-prone areas**: This is crucial as it prevents human habitation in high-risk zones, reducing the risk to life and property.
 
• C. Building strong walls</s
